tools.name: get_builder
tools.description: One HyperCore builder code over a window (24h to all since 2025-07-19): fees (USD stablecoins at par, exact per token), volume, fills, users, rank; one row per day; its markets; its orders from 2026-10-13 15:50 UTC by status (fills, cancels, each rejection reason) and the fee rates they charged.

tools.name: get_builder_fills
tools.description: Fills of one HyperCore builder code, newest first, with the builder fee of each, account, market, price, size, direction, PnL, oid, tid and hash. From 2025-07-19; window from / to, default the last 24 h, at most 24 h per call. Next page: pass `next_cursor` as cursor.

tools.name: get_deploys
tools.description: HyperCore deploy actions, newest first: `perpDeploy` (HIP-3 perp dexs: market registrations, halts, funding rates, open interest caps, margin tables, sub-deployers…), `spotDeploy` (HIP-1 tokens and spot pairs), `outcomeDeploy` and `activateOutcomeDeployer` (HIP-4 outcomes), `VoteGlobalAction` (valid

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create an outgoing webhook: we POST the events of its subscriptions to your HTTPS URL (port 443 or 8443, public address), signed (Standard Webhooks: webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature = v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "id.timestamp.body" with the secret>). Channels (WebSocket vocabulary): br

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Your account's webhooks: URL, state (pending_verification, active, disabled with the reason and how to enable), failures in a row, subscriptions. A rotated key sees the same webhooks. Next page: pass `next_cursor` as cursor.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: One of your webhooks: state (pending_verification, active, or disabled with the reason and how to turn it on), failures in a row, subscriptions with their seq, today's deliveries against your tier's daily limit.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Change a webhook: url (verified again by a webhook.verification challenge before anything else is sent), description, or subscriptions (the whole list: unchanged ones keep their seq).

tools.name: enable_webhook
tools.description: Turn a disabled webhook (410 Gone, or failing for 24 h) on again: your URL gets a new webhook.verification challenge, deliveries resume once it is answered; pending ones are kept 7 days.

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: A new whsec_ signing secret, answered once; for 24 h every delivery carries two signatures (the new and the previous secret): accept either while you switch.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete one of your webhooks and its pending deliveries. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Queue a webhook.test delivery to a verified webhook (not billed); its result shows in get_webhook_deliveries within seconds.

tools.name: get_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Deliveries of one webhook, newest first (kept 7 days): msgId (the webhook-id header), type, status pending / delivered / dead, and each attempt with its HTTP status, latency, error and the first 4 KiB of your answer. Next page: pass `next_cursor` as cursor.

tools.name: replay_webhook
tools.description: Send deliveries again, same webhook-id (dedupe on it): one (msgId, delivered or dead), or every dead one since a time (since, Unix ms within 7 days; status all: delivered ones too).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your Femtos account: name, tier and limits in force, balance and debt (USD), credits used this month and free credits left, monthly cap, plan and renewal, how to pay (USDC deposit address, card, x402), how rotate/delete are confirmed (manageWith). Start here to manage the account. Free.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Your usage per UTC day and call class (rest, medium, heavy, hl, ws_bytes, webhook): calls or bytes, credits, USD charged. Free.

tools.name: get_ledger
tools.description: Your money movements, newest first: USDC deposits and x402 packs (with tx), card payments, credits by Femtos, plans paid from the balance, refunds; usage debits with usage=true. With the balance now. Next page: pass `next_cursor` as cursor. Free.

tools.name: get_deposits
tools.description: Your USDC deposit address on each chain (HyperCore, HyperEVM, Base, Arbitrum One), amounts waiting to reach the minimum, and its latest deposits: amount, tx, pending / credited / ignored with the reason. Free.

tools.name: get_deposit_address
tools.description: Your USDC deposit address (created on the first call, then the same): send USDC on HyperCore (usdSend), HyperEVM, Base or Arbitrum One (ERC-20 transfer) and it is credited 1:1 to your balance. Answers how to pay on each chain. Free.

tools.name: get_payment_options
tools.description: How to pay your account now: your USDC deposit address on each chain with exact instructions, x402 credit packs, a card checkout URL when cards are offered (give usd), and the credits an amount buys. Free.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: The price list: credits per call class (and which calls are medium / heavy), pay-as-you-go bands, plans with their monthly and annual price and included credits, payment methods. Use it before subscribe_plan. Free.

tools.name: subscribe_plan
tools.description: Subscribe to a plan (get_plans lists them): paid from your USDC balance now (interval month, or year = 12 months prepaid at a discount) and renewed from it, or by card (checkout URL). Spends money. 402 insufficient_balance says how much to deposit. Free.

tools.name: cancel_plan
tools.description: Stop your plan from renewing: it runs to its period end (no refund), then the key is back on pay as you go. subscribe_plan before then resumes it. Free.

tools.name: quote_wallet_payment
tools.description: Step 1 of paying from an EVM wallet with USDC (Base, Arbitrum One or HyperEVM), no gas: the EIP-712 typed data of a USDC TransferWithAuthorization to sign with eth_signTypedData_v4, for a plan (planId, interval: what the balance lacks) or a top-up (usd). Then pay_with_wallet with the signature. Free

tools.name: pay_with_wallet
tools.description: Step 2: send chain, authorization (the quote typedData.message), signature, and the planId / interval or usd of the quote. Femtos settles it on chain (no gas for you) and credits the account or buys the plan. state pending: call again with the same body after retryAfter (never charged twice). Spends

tools.name: set_spending_cap
tools.description: Set your monthly spending cap in USD (null lifts it). Past it, heavy and medium calls answer 402 until next month. Answers the billing view. Free.

tools.name: rotate_key
tools.description: Replace your API key: the new one is answered once, the current one (the one this MCP connection uses) stops working at once: reconnect with the new key. Needs management_secret (agents); an account with an email gets a confirmation link instead. Free.

tools.name: freeze_key
tools.description: Emergency stop for a leaked key: it is refused everywhere at once, this MCP connection included. Unfreeze or rotate it after with your management secret (POST /v1/account/unfreeze, /v1/account/rotate). Free.

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description: Delete your account: the key stops working for good. Refused while a plan runs or overage is due; a positive balance is lost only with forfeit_balance=true. Needs management_secret (agents); an account with an email gets a confirmation link. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_signup_challenge
tools.description: No key needed. Step 1 of a free API key for an agent: a proof-of-work challenge. Find a nonce of 1-32 characters [0-9a-zA-Z] such that SHA-256 of "<salt>:<nonce>" starts with `difficulty` zero bits (run code: about 0.5 M hashes), then call signup.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: No key needed. Step 2: send agent_name with the solved salt and nonce; answers a free API key and a management secret, each once: save both (the secret rotates, unfreezes and deletes the account). Then connect with Authorization: Bearer <key>.

tools.name: get_recovery_challenge
tools.description: No key needed. Lost the key of an account created by an x402 payment? Get the message its paying wallet must sign (personal_sign), then call recover_account. EOA wallets only.

tools.name: recover_account
tools.description: No key needed. Send wallet, nonce and the signature of the recovery message: answers a new key and management secret (save both), the old ones stop working.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_top_tokens" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
